Subject: Re: Initial Enablement — calendar sync & session scope

Hi Jonas / Marissa,

Thanks for the demo yesterday — the team found the console overview helpful. We'd like to lock in a hands-on enablement session next week focused on:
- Console admin flows (service accounts, role mapping)
- API key rotation and examples for our ingestion pipeline
- A brief walkthrough of the SDK snippets and best practices for batching

Our engineering manager Matt and I are available next Tue/Wed afternoons (PDT). Can you share a 60–90 min window that covers both the console deep-dive and an API sandbox walkthrough?

Also, could you send any pre-reads or a checklist we should complete beforehand? We'll try to have an engineer join.

Best,
Samira Khan
Director, Engineering Operations
Oceanside Health

Hi Samira — great to hear.

Thanks for outlining the priorities. Proposed plan: 75 minutes total split as follows — 25m console admin (roles, service accounts), 35m API sandbox & SDK examples (including a live token rotation demo), 15m Q&A / next steps. We'll also include a short checklist you can complete beforehand to speed setup.

Availability: Tue Apr 7 2:00–4:30pm PDT or Wed Apr 8 3:00–5:00pm PDT. Please let us know which slot you prefer and whether you want the meeting recorded. I'll send a calendar invite once confirmed.

Prep: I'll attach the checklist and a short slide deck. If Matt has specific integration questions, please share them so Dev can prepare code snippets.

Thanks,
Jonas Weber
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

Thanks for the quick responses — Tue 4/7 2:30pm PDT is confirmed. I've sent a calendar invite (attached .ics) to all participants with Zoom details and an agenda.

Agenda (75m):
- 0–25m: Console admin & RBAC (Marissa)
- 25–60m: API sandbox & SDK examples (Jonas + Dev)
- 60–75m: Q&A, next steps, docs linkback

Prep (please complete if possible before the session):
- Create the service account listed in the checklist or confirm an existing one we can use
- Add Matt and Samira to the project-level viewer role (temporary) so we can demo token rotation
- Share any short sample payloads or a sequence-length distribution so we can tailor the batching recommendations

If anything changes, reply-all and we'll re-run scheduling. Looking forward to it!
